title: 🔒 Save integrity and reward fixes
body:
Three fixes that protect what you have earned.

Your eggs are now covered by the save's tamper seal. They were supposed to be, but a typo meant the check looked at an old unused field and never saw them at all — so an edited save could conjure a finished egg and skip the 500,000 $CHIKI cost.

A momentary failure to read your wallet can no longer wipe your balance ceiling. If the check came back empty because of a hiccup rather than because your wallet was empty, the game believed it instantly. It now waits for a second reading before accepting a zero.

And if you started playing after the 24 July chapter update, your completed chapters are no longer wrongly marked as already paid — that was quietly blocking real $CHIKI you were owed.

title: ⚔️ Duels are real now
body:
Walking up to another trainer and pressing G used to start a practice fight against a copy of them run by your own game — they were never told it happened and never played. Now it sends them a real challenge. They can accept or decline, and if they accept you fight each other for real, with the server refereeing every turn. Still no $CHIKI and no stakes.

You can also now receive a challenge, which was never possible before.

title: 🪓 Tools that hang right, and fairer contested nodes
body:
Every gathering tool is rebuilt to a single shared orientation. The ten levels of each axe, pickaxe, shovel and drill had been modelled facing different ways — some blades sat edge-on and looked like a thin sliver in your hands — so no single swing angle could ever be right for all of them. They now all hang the same way, and other trainers see your tool held exactly as you do rather than at a flat angle. Nothing about how gathering works has changed.

Also fixed: if two trainers reached the same node at the same moment, BOTH walked away with the item. The loser now correctly gets nothing and is told someone beat them to it — and a full bag can never lose you resources you already had. And cancelling a listing the market had already let go no longer destroys your goods while telling you they sold; your items stay put.

title: 🐟 The same fish for everyone
body: Every fishing spot stocked itself differently for each player. Two trainers standing at the same named cove were genuinely fishing different water — and because species differ in rarity and value, the same spot could quietly be worth more to one of you than the other. Schools are now stocked from the world itself, so the fish at a spot are the same fish for everybody. Catch rates, rarity and everything you do with a rod are unchanged.

title: 🌲 One forest for everyone
body: Trees were the last resource that each player kept privately. Two trainers could work the same trunk and each see a different forest — one of you felled a tree the other still saw standing. The world now keeps a tree's remaining loads, exactly as it already did for ore, rocks and hives. A trunk another trainer has been working is worked-down for you too, and the tree that finally falls falls for everyone. Nothing about chopping changes: still one wood per swing, still three loads in a full tree, and your swing lands instantly as before. Also fixed: when a lot of trainers were in the world you could be standing right next to someone and not see them at all. The game kept the first sixty players it happened to know about — oldest sessions, not nearest — so anyone who joined later, or reconnected, could be invisible from a few steps away. It now always shows you the sixty nearest trainers.

title: 🪓 Fixed: other players looked like they just stopped
body: When another trainer was gathering you saw them standing still. Their action was reaching you correctly — the problem was that the avatars have no animation named 'chop' or 'mine', so the game asked for one that didn't exist and fell back to standing idle. Gathering actions now play the swing the rigs actually have, so you can see people working from across the clearing. Also fixed: a cow or pig you were hunting would calmly wander off mid-swing, because the hold on it was re-checked by distance every frame and the animal drifted out of its own hunt. It now stays held until you stop.

title: ⚔ Duels are real multiplayer now
body: A duel against another trainer is refereed by the server, not by each of you guessing. You both see the same turn, the same hand size and the same health, and a turn only resolves once BOTH of you have locked in — no more one-sided fights or desyncs. Your hand is dealt by the server and every one of your six cards is reachable; the card row has been widened to fit them. Walking out mid-duel is now an honest forfeit that ends the match for your opponent immediately, instead of leaving them waiting. Wild corruptimon fights are untouched and still play exactly as before.

title: 📖 The Codex is now a proper how-to
body: The Codex tab has been rebuilt as a guide to the whole game. Twenty-two topics — getting started, eggs, your team, gathering, fishing, crafting, brewing, cooking, battling, PvP and the Cup, mounts, the Trading Post, the three mines, hunting, quests, the $CHIKI economy, collectibles, avatar perks, movement and stamina, map and waypoints, playing together, and caring for your chikimon. Tap any one and you get the real mechanics: numbered steps for exactly what to do in game, then the hard numbers — costs, timers, drop odds, fee splits. No vague advice; if the game rolls a 1-in-1250, it says so.

title: 🌍 One world — everyone sees the same Chikoria
body: Other trainers are no longer sliding mannequins. Whatever they're doing reaches you: someone chopping across the clearing swings a real axe, a miner works a pickaxe, a prospector runs a drill, an angler holds a rod — the same models, in the same hands, as your own. Jumps show up too; heights are shared now, so a leap actually reads as a leap instead of a slide along the ground. Their chikimon finally trail at the RIGHT distance — remote pets were following about three times closer than yours do, which is why other people's teams looked glued to their heels. And resources are one shared world: the rock you mine is the same rock everyone else sees, so it can't be harvested twice, and it comes back for the whole realm at once.

title: 🪓 Three chops a tree — and then it falls
body: Trees are proper resource nodes now: each trunk holds THREE loads of firewood instead of one, so you work the same tree three times before it's spent. Each chop still gives exactly one wood — the one-item-per-gather rule is untouched, there's simply more in each tree, and the message tells you how many loads are left. Take the last one and the tree TOPPLES: it hangs, creaks, then goes over fast and settles into the grass on its own bearing, so a worked patch really looks logged. A felled trunk stops blocking you, and in time a fresh tree stands in its place, full again.

title: 📍 Your map pin now stands in the world
body: Drop a waypoint on the minimap and a golden beacon rises at that exact spot in Chikoria — a shaft of light you can pick out from across a region, a ring on the ground where it actually lands, and the same pin marker floating above it, drawn on top of the landscape so a hill can never hide your destination. It dims as you walk up to it, and right-clicking the map clears both the pin and its beacon together.

title: 📊 The Statistics board, rebuilt
body: Every realm figure is now its own card — reward pool, $CHIKI earned and burned, circulating supply, Chikorians online, active chikimons, holders and trainers — each with its own artwork and a one-tap link to verify it on-chain. The numbers refresh every few seconds while the board is open instead of every half-minute, the online count updates live between refreshes, and a line at the bottom tells you exactly how fresh what you're reading is.

title: 🗺 A living map of Chikoria
body: Open the minimap in the top-left and the whole island is yours at a glance — your heading, every shop and landmark, ore and berry nodes, other players moving in real time, and the corruptimons you'd rather walk around. Click it for the full-screen chart, zoom through four levels, and drop a waypoint anywhere you want to remember. A legend explains every marker.

title: 🛒 Fixed: sold listings coming back from the dead
body: A listing you'd already sold could reappear in the Buy tab and be bought a SECOND time, duplicating the goods. That's fixed at the root — once a listing is settled it can never be resurrected, no matter how the stalls reconcile. We hammered it with hundreds of randomized trading rounds plus targeted double-buy and simultaneous-buyer tests before shipping. The Trading Post also refreshes every few seconds while you're standing at a stall, so listings, sales and buyouts appear as they happen.

title: 🌍 Other players feel like they're really there
body: Remote riders now show the mount they're actually on instead of walking on air, their chikimon trail in a proper formation instead of clipping through their heels, and everyone's movement is smoothed with the same interpolation technique the big MMOs use — less rubber-banding, truer positions.

title: ⛏ Gathering feels right again
body: The timing-bar experiment is gone — gathering is back to the honest, no-gimmick version, and one gather still gives exactly one item. Your tools swing properly too: the axe bites the tree with its blade instead of its back, the pickaxe drives its point into stone, and the drill faces the crystal instead of your own spine. We measured the tool models to get these angles right rather than eyeballing them.

title: 🏃 Running now costs breath
body: Sprinting is no longer infinite. You get a stamina meter that drains as you run and recovers when you ease off — and how long you last scales with your level AND the boots you're wearing, so better gear genuinely buys you more ground. Run yourself out and you'll be winded for a moment before you can bolt again.

title: 🐴 Your steeds got their true colors back
body: Every mount was rendering far darker than its artwork — a color-space mismatch buried in the rigs. All six have been rebalanced to match their real palette. Dashing was fixed too: mounts now dash on YOUR command with a proper cooldown, each one's speed and stamina matching its temperament, instead of dashing constantly or never at all.

title: ✨ Quality-of-life pass
body: Feed your mounts straight from the Mounts tab without digging through the satchel. Pressing SPACE now always jumps — it no longer re-triggers whatever button you last clicked. Hungry steeds, waypoints, feeding and the chat's Latest jump are all called out with proper artwork instead of placeholder symbols.

title: 🛡 Your marketplace $CHIKI is locked down
body: A deep security pass rebuilt how the Trading Post settles. Every sale, auction and order is now tied to YOUR wallet by a signed session — no stranger can touch, clear or hide the proceeds you're owed, and nothing is ever deleted before you're actually paid. Money you're owed now survives 60 days if you're away (instead of quietly expiring), and on-chain buys can't be double-charged or replayed. If a sale ever settled and the $CHIKI didn't reach you, the realm now pays it out reliably — just sign in.

title: ⚔ Rivals fight back — real duels at last
body: PvP and Chikoria Cup duels are no longer a stat check. Your rival now plays a REAL hand — spending energy on strikes, guards, drains and charges, raising a shield against your combos, and going for the kill when your chikimon drops low. Read its telegraphs, bait out its guard, and time your burst. Every duel is a fight now.

title: 🥚 Eggs grow while you're away — plus a big feel pass
body: Nesting eggs now keep growing while the game is closed — warm one, then go live your life and come back to a hatchling. Mounts stay fed far longer (no more starving mid-ride), landing a fish is more forgiving, the jump no longer eats a late tap on uneven ground, and the News & System chat tabs finally let you scroll up through the whole history. Egg fish costs dropped hard, too: a Meme Egg now needs just ONE Rainbow Fish.

title: 📈 Progression rebalance
body: Trainer (Avatar) levels now take more to earn, so each rank you reach means more. In exchange your CHIKIMON level up faster, and their full 12-card ability kit is now in hand by Level 45 instead of being back-loaded to 50 — every chikimon shows its whole personality sooner.

title: 📜 Every chapter now pays REAL $CHIKI
body: All 63 story chapters of Act I now pay REAL on-chain $CHIKI — the 42 chapters that used to pay soft coins have been promoted. A full campaign run is now worth 112,030 REAL $CHIKI in your Reward Vault (open the LEDGER tab to track it). Already claimed those chapters? You're covered: the realm re-reports them to the vault automatically the next time you log in. The first 10 trainers to finish Chapter 63 still take home the 1,000,000 $CHIKI champion prize.

title: 🔨 The Auction House opens — chikimon go under the hammer
body: Chikimon are no longer sold at flat prices. The Trading Post's new Auction tab puts every chikimon under a 12-hour hammer: set an opening bid, watch trainers outbid each other, and the highest bid wins when time runs out. Outbid? Your escrowed $CHIKI returns instantly. Sellers keep 75% of the hammer price (20% reward pool, 5% burned). Rare chikimon finally sell for what the realm thinks they're worth.

title: 🔒 One wallet, one save
body: Every wallet now has its OWN save. Switching wallets swaps to that trainer's world; disconnecting locks your progress away until you sign back in — nothing lingers on a shared device. Tip: to play a different wallet, switch the active account inside Phantom itself, then connect. Need a clean slate on this device? Visit /realm/?wipelocal — cloud-saved progress returns when you sign in.

title: ⚖ Trade pay restored — automatic restitution
body: A bug let a hidden safety cap swallow order-fill and sale payments for some traders — the goods moved, the $CHIKI didn't. Fixed, and the realm makes it right on its own: sign in and every payment the cap held back is re-credited automatically from your own sales receipts. Going forward the cap grows with your trade income, so a payment can never vanish again.

title: ⚡ FREE-PLAY EVENT — the gates close July 26!
body: For a limited time, Chikoria needs NO $CHIKI to enter. Sign in with your Phantom wallet — any balance, even zero — and walk in as the Wanderer with one chikimon egg to your name. Keep it warm, tend it in the Team tab, and it hatches your first companion. Every feature is yours: gather, craft, fish, battle, trade. And a permanent change ships with it: every egg now hatches ONLY its own kind — normal eggs hatch normals, legendary eggs hatch legendaries. No more lottery inside the shell. ⏳ The free gates close on JULY 26 — enter before then and your account, egg and progress stay yours forever.

title: 🥚 Fixed: vanishing eggs
body: A save-verification bug shipped with the Craft Orders update was wrongly flagging honest saves as tampered on every reload — and the anti-cheat's tamper response cleared nesting eggs, chests and the reward vault. The stamp is fixed, every save written during the bad window is recognized as legitimate again, and any wrongly-applied tamper mark is cleared automatically the next time you load. Real save-editing is still detected and punished exactly as before. If your egg vanished during the window, reach out — we can see affected accounts.

title: 🎮 Pocket Realm, rebuilt for thumbs
body: The mobile island got a full make-over: the castle, town walls, shops, streetlights, trees and resource models now render at 4-6x fewer blocks (your trainer, chikimon and other players stay full-detail), the cobblestone road smoothed into a clean plain road, and every label grew ~20% so nothing squints. The touch controls are now carved wood and gold like the rest of the realm — joystick low-left, E / JUMP / RUN in the open lower-right, clear of every panel and bar. And long trainer names now fit their nameplate banner perfectly.

title: 🌍 Fixed: PCs stuck at 82%
body: Some desktops — mostly touchscreen laptops or screens on high display scaling — were being mistaken for phones. They got the mobile game pack and a phone-sized engine thread pool, which stalled the load at exactly 82% and could crash the tab, or dropped you into the mobile version on a PC. Device detection is now exact: phones get the pocket build, every desktop and tablet gets the full build. If you were stuck at 82%, it was never your PC — try again.

title: 🔗 Choose your door: Wallet or Demo
body: The realm no longer assumes who you are. Every session now opens on a clear choice: CONNECT your Phantom wallet to load your real trainer, progress and $CHIKI — or PLAY DEMO to try the whole island first as the Wanderer with three random chikimon and a mount. The demo is a sealed sandbox: explore, gather, fish and battle everywhere, but nothing saves, nothing earns, no trading, and it never touches the live world — reload and connect whenever you're ready to make it real.

title: ⚡ The island learned to sleep
body: A deep performance pass, biggest on phones: the screen now renders at a sane pixel density on 3× retina displays (the UI was being painted at NINE times the pixels it needed), the ocean dropped to a fraction of its triangles on mobile, and the world finally sleeps when you're not looking — far fish schools, livestock, corruptimons and trees all pause simulation and drawing until you approach. The fixed sky no longer recomputes itself every frame either. Desktop looks identical; phones just breathe.

title: 📜 Ancient recipes + Craft Orders
body: Two big economy unlocks. ANCIENT RECIPES: the five sealed landmarks — the wicked temple, the raid altar, the crystal lode, the sunken galleon and the leviathan's cove — now each whisper a lost double-batch brewing recipe when you stand close and read their legend. Find all five and your cauldron yields 2× on those brews forever. CRAFT ORDERS: the Trading Post's new 📥 Orders tab lets you post what you NEED ("WTB 20 hide — 400 $CHIKI"). Your offer is escrowed on the spot; any trainer holding the goods taps Fill, hands them over and keeps 75%. Three open orders max, auto-refund after 25h.

title: 🔨 Crafting, refined
body: Brewing grew up: potions and food now craft ×5 or MAX in one tap (with a live 'can make N' count), every missing material tells you exactly WHERE to get it when you hover its red chip, and the artisan's secret is out — every craft has a 12% MASTERWORK chance that refunds half the materials. Gear ladders are untouched: each tier is still a one-off upgrade.

title: ⚡ Phones got a serious speed-up
body: Mobile now skips building what it never shows: the 168,000-blade grass field, the cloud layer, weather particles and the dynamic street-lamp lights simply don't exist on phones (lamps still glow at night). The world streams a tighter bubble around you. Your avatar, chikimon, and every building look exactly the same — the frame rate doesn't.

title: 🛡 Fairness & mobile hardening
body: A deep audit pass: one-tap Collect now banks BOTH purses (with the amount on the button and honest ceiling handling), phones always start on LOW graphics with a tighter world bubble, the touch joystick lives in its own bottom-left box, the reel duel is finally winnable by holding the Action button, joystick deflection cancels a gather, and the sideways mode survives every refresh. Plus a save-tampering hole was welded shut.

title: 🎣 The legends grew rarer
body: Fantasy fish are now 2× harder to hook across the board — Golden Chikifish 1-in-167, Crystal Koi 1-in-500, Mystic Eel 1-in-1429, Rainbow Fish 1-in-5000 base per cast (before your rod bonus and spot richness). Landing one MEANS something.

title: 🌟 Pocket Realm — mobile got HALF the weight
body: Phones now download a dedicated mobile-lite pack: half the bytes, a quarter of the texture memory — made for wallet browsers like Phantom. Desktop keeps full HD. Everyone also saves 50MB from a build-time cleanup, and the loader now survives connection hiccups with automatic retries.

title: 📜 System log + Update board + XP bar
body: The Chat box gained a SYSTEM tab — a timestamped history of every notification (XP, purchases, level-ups, hatches) so nothing vanishes with the toast. This very Update Board is now LIVE-fed each deploy. And your trainer level + XP progress sits under the logo, always on screen.

title: 🏃 Hold to run
body: Mouse-first movement grew up: quick-click walks you there; HOLD the button ~¼s and your avatar breaks into a RUN, steering after your cursor the whole time. Release and they finish the trip on their own.

title: 🌟 Sideways mode for wallet browsers
body: Phantom's in-app browser can't rotate — so now Chikoria rotates FOR you. Pick which way you'll turn your phone and the whole realm plays fullscreen landscape inside the portrait browser. Your choice is remembered; a tiny corner chip flips sides.

title: 🌍 Multiplayer rendering v2
body: Other trainers now stand on the TRUE ground (no more sinking), bring their whole 3-chikimon party trailing in formation at real size, and move with buttery MMO-grade motion smoothing. Far-off trainers cost nothing until you approach.

title: 📊 Smart collection pop-ups
body: Chikidex, Mountdex and Avatars gained live progress meters, Meme Dynasty scarcity bars (minted / cap), rarity glow on what you own, owned-first sorting, a 🎯 'next to finish' nudge — and the 3D viewer now compares any steed or chikimon against YOURS.
